name: claude-control-tower-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Claude Control Tower — the mission control cockpit for Claude Code.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['packages/core','packages/render','packages/collectors','packages/plugin-sdk','packages/cli']) { require('node:fs').rmSync(p + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync(p + '/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', { force: true }); }"

overridesRationale.esbuild: <=0.28.0 carries two dev-server advisories (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99, GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr). We never run its dev server, but a public repo should audit clean, so tsup and vite are pinned forward to the patched line.
